topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic serves as the introductory framing for the lecture, outlining its scope and connection to prior material.

topics.label: Principles of Innate Immune Recognition and Target Discrimination
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts of how the innate immune system identifies threats by detecting PAMPs and DAMPs through germline-encoded receptors localized across cellular compartments.

topics.label: Toll-Like Receptor Architecture and Signaling Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the structure, localization, ligand binding, and downstream transcriptional signaling cascades of Toll-like receptors.

topics.label: Cytosolic Pattern Recognition and Inflammasome Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe alternative intracellular sensor families and the assembly of the inflammasome complex required for proteolytic cytokine activation.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cascade: Sentinel Activation, Leukocyte Trafficking, and Systemic Effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the cellular execution of acute inflammation, encompassing mediator release by sentinel cells, leukocyte extravasation, lymphatic priming, and systemic complications such as septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the active and passive mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation, mediate tissue regeneration, and drive chronic responses such as granuloma formation when pathogens persist.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing, wrapping up the session and previewing the next lecture.
